--help.stdout:
usage: sot [-h] [-V] [--root ROOT] [--db DB]
           {engine,search,embed,explore,usages,implementations,rename,map,insert,reconcile,batch-reconcile,verify,doctor,clean,vacuum,mcp,report,cluster,viz,export,bundle,setup,pack,watch,trace,import-scip,ui-tree,be-flow,solution,scope-receipt,receipt,providers,diff-impact,claims,log,commits} ...

sot-graph: Verified, self-healing knowledge graph for AI coding agents.

positional arguments:
  {engine,search,embed,explore,usages,implementations,rename,map,insert,reconcile,batch-reconcile,verify,doctor,clean,vacuum,mcp,report,cluster,viz,export,bundle,setup,pack,watch,trace,import-scip,ui-tree,be-flow,solution,scope-receipt,receipt,providers,diff-impact,claims,log,commits}
    engine              Explicit local engine artifact administration
                        (experimental)
    search              Ranked search with Trust Verdicts
    embed               Build/refresh the optional vector index ([vector]
                        extra)
    explore             Explore AST relations and cross-file edges
    usages              List every reference site of a symbol, grouped by
                        caller
    implementations     Show extends/implements relationships of a symbol
    rename              Report-only impact plan for renaming a symbol
    map                 Token-budgeted repo map ranked by personalized
                        PageRank
    insert              Insert a reusable piece of knowledge or decision
    reconcile           Idempotently sync graph with filesystem
    batch-reconcile     Batch reconcile multiple repositories concurrently
    verify              Check for drift between graph and filesystem (CI-safe)
    doctor              Check database and graph health statistics
    clean               Remove stale or reset graph data safely
    vacuum              Compact the SQLite database
    mcp                 Run the optional MCP stdio server
    report              Generate comprehensive architectural markdown report
    cluster             Detect and inspect architectural communities/clusters
    viz                 Generate standalone interactive HTML graph visualizer
    export              Export knowledge graph to GraphRAG JSON, Obsidian,
                        GraphML, or SCIP
    bundle              Extract 5 high-density fact bundle markdown files for
                        LLM architecture reports
    setup               Configure AI coding harnesses (OMP / Pi, OpenCode,
                        Antigravity, Claude, ZCode)
    pack                Package a k-hop ContextBundle (YAML) for AI agent
                        prompt registers
    watch               Watch filesystem and reconcile in real time (daemon &
                        multi-project support)
    trace               Extract Full-Stack execution path, UI decisions, API
                        binding, and Mermaid diagrams
    import-scip         Import compiler-backed SCIP index into Multi-Provider
                        Evidence Storage
    ui-tree             Extract local Frontend UI decision tree, validation
                        rules, and modals
    be-flow             Extract Backend processing steps, multi-datasources,
                        and exception branches
    solution            Automated Solution Architecture and Manpower
                        Estimation Engine
    scope-receipt       PRE-change bounded evidence receipt for one edit
                        target
    receipt             Human-readable view of serialized assurance receipts
                        (read-only, SG-205)
    providers           Detect, list, and diagnose evidence providers (read-
                        only)
    diff-impact         Git diff blast radius, upstream caller traversal, and
                        API impact analysis
    claims              Lint public trust claims in docs against the claim
                        registry (SG-110)
    log (commits)       Inspect git commit history with automated risk scoring
                        and impacted symbols

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  -V, --version         show program's version number and exit
  --root ROOT           Project root directory (default: current dir)
  --db DB               Custom SQLite DB path (default: .sot/sot.db)

engine --help.stdout:
usage: sot engine [-h] --store STORE [--name NAME]
                  {import,promote,rollback,status,doctor,prepare,probe,sync,search,runtime-status} ...

positional arguments:
  {import,promote,rollback,status,doctor,prepare,probe,sync,search,runtime-status}
    import              Verify and stage an explicit local artifact; never
                        activate automatically
    promote             Select an already verified digest; preserve all data
    rollback            Select an already verified digest; preserve all data
    status              Verify selected artifact without spawning an engine
    doctor              Report artifact identity and experimental limitations
    prepare             Explicit managed SOT operation (experimental)
    probe               Explicit managed SOT operation (experimental)
    sync                Explicit managed SOT operation (experimental)
    search              Explicit managed SOT operation (experimental)
    runtime-status      Explicit managed SOT operation (experimental)

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --store STORE         Private absolute store outside the repository
  --name NAME
